name: Flight of the Conchords
description:
'''Flight of the Conchords''' are a New Zealand musical comedy duo formed in [[Wellington]] in 1998. The band consists of multi-instrumentalists [[Bret McKenzie]] and [[Jemaine Clement]]. The duo began as a popular live comedy act in the early 2000s, and their blend of comedy and music subsequently became the basis of the self-titled [[Flight of the Conchords (radio series)|BBC radio series]] (2005) and, later, the [[HBO]] series ''[[Flight of the Conchords (TV series)|Flight of the Conchords]]'' (2007–2009). They released their first full-length comedy special, ''[[Live in London (Flight of the Conchords album)|Live in London]]'', in October 2018 on HBO, followed by a live album release through [[Sub Pop]] in March 2019.

The duo's live performances combine skits, audience interactions, and songs, and they continue to tour periodically. They received a nomination for the [[Perrier Comedy Award]] at the [[2003 Edinburgh Festival Fringe]], were named Best Newcomer at the 2003 [[Melbourne International Comedy Festival]], and were named Best Alternative Comedy Act at the 2005 [[The Comedy Festival|US Comedy Arts Festival]]. They have been nominated three times for a [[Grammy Award]]—winning [[Grammy Award for Best Comedy Album|Best Comedy Album]] in 2008—and have received eight [[Primetime Emmy Awards|Primetime Emmy Award]] nominations.
